song_craft: Voice: hammer couplets to the end — but the hammer now proclaims (vīra/utsāha replace demolition-wonder). Arc: breath demoted (vv19–22) → rest unfolds to lordship (v23) → Māyā named (v24) → mother proclaimed (v25) → fence (v26) → VERDICT double-held (v27). Four proclaiming verbs (sung/told/proclaimed/said per rasa). L3 tight incl. verbless nominals: L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Unproved by never spreading — though knowing-clad and all —
breath and kin rank knowable, never knower. Else, straying.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na siddho 'prathanād eva jñānādisamavāyy api tat prāṇādi prameyaṃ syān na pramātānyato bhramāt

verses.craft: Demotion hammer; end-weight straying walks (bhrama enacted, not labeled).
verses.rejected: (a) delusion (L2) → killed: L3 frozen + straying walks. (b) softening never → killed: demotion is total.
